output.summary: A deciduous shrub native to central and southern Europe, southern England, northwest Africa and western Asia, European barberry has three-branched spines, yellow flowers and oblong red berries. Its sharply acidic berries are eaten fresh and traditionally used for jam and cooking, especially in southwestern Asia.
output.edibilityNote: The sharply acidic berries are eaten fresh and traditionally used in jam; in southwestern Asia, especially Iran, they are used in cooking.
